_scope: the 200 cases in the frozen evaluation selection

panel_interpretations.scorer_rule: Intermediate is neither covering nor failing. A case whose best available verdict on some isolate is Intermediate scores INTERMEDIATE_ONLY, its own class, and is excluded from adequacy numerators and from the paired test.

case_drug_pairs.meaning: UNDETERMINED means the laboratory never tested that agent against at least one isolate on that patient. It is a property of what the laboratory chose to test.

coverage_ceiling.meaning: the best any single-agent policy could achieve on this cohort with perfect per-patient choice. The baseline is measured against this, not against 100.

gram_positive_agents_in_the_formulary.note: these can never be adequate on a Gram-negative cohort, which is why an encoder that answers vancomycin every time scores 0 adequate rather than scoring wrong
